method: Real xlsx binaries downloaded from Drive, decoded, SHA-256 hashed, parsed with SheetJS (xlsx npm package) for cell values and formulas. Comparison run against src/calc/geometry/frameGeometry.ts computeFrameCount (read-only, not executed via the live UI).

hangarType.value: Спринт-М / каркас под профнастил, окрашенный (наружная обшивка C12='окрашенный профлист')

roofSlope_deg.note: matches app default roofSlopeDeg=15 in src/calc/geometry test fixtures

liveSheet.note: sheet tab NAME does not reliably indicate span; only the sheet containing the literal TZ number in G5 is live, others are stale template copies

wallGirtSelectionResult.reason: This workbook is the MAIN project frame/BOM calculator, not 'Калькулятор ограждайки v1.5.xlsx'. It has no wind-pressure-driven auto-selection, no aerodynamic coefficient, no k(ze) table — none of the inputs src/calc/wallGirt/windLoad.ts implements appear anywhere in this sheet. Instead it computes wall material as a flat, enclosure-conditional quantity formula (profile family ПП/ПС at various sizes, e.g. row 34-39) plus a single 'Кронштейны' (brackets) row with linear-meter and mass formulas summing zone perimeters. No single 'selected profile + шаг ригелей + число рядов' output exists in the form our wallGirt.ts model produces.
wallGirtSelectionResult.bracketsRow: B37/B38/B41 depending on file (label 'Кронштейны'), formula pattern: linear_m = mass_kg/0.75*0.2, mass_kg = sum of zone-perimeter terms * 2

postsBranch.note: No cell anywhere in the live sheet contains the substring 'стойк' (searched full A1:AI range).

openings.note: Unit price cells for openings reference an external closed workbook (e.g. '[7]Перекупные '!$F$65) — cached values only, price formula NOT independently re-derivable without that external file.

frameCountComparison.appFunction: computeFrameCount (src/calc/geometry/frameGeometry.ts:25) = Math.ceil(length_m/framePitch_m) + widenedBays.length + 1, with widenedBays=[] here
